headline: Crypto Weekly: Coinbase feels crypto squeeze, South Africa's new rules
summary: STORY: From crypto giants feeling the squeeze to South Africa's new crypto rules...This is Crypto Weekly.:: Crypto Weekly:: Coinbase posts third straight quarterly lossCoinbase posted a third straight quarterly loss.The crypto giant saw a drop of close to $360 million for the quarter ended June 30 - well down from a profit of $1.43 billion a year earlier.Crypto markets came under pressure during the April-to-June quarter.Investors turned away from riskier assets due to uncertainty over U.S. interest rates, geopolitical tensions and outflows from crypto investment products.:: Trump-backed American Bitcoin swings to quarterly lossAmerican Bitcoin was another company to feel the mood sour around crypto.The bitcoin miner is backed by two of U.S. President Donald Trump's sons.Its net loss hit just over $57 million as bitcoin prices slid 11% from April to June.:: South Africa drafts new crypto rulesSouth Africa took a step closer to bringing crypto into its financial rulebook.The country released draft guidelines for the first time on when moving crypto across borders becomes a regulated and reportable event.The draft Crypto Asset Manual was published jointly by the National Treasury and the South African Reserve Bank, and comes as crypto use widens in the country.:: Robinhood Markets sees weakness in crypto tradingAnd Robinhood Markets beat Wall Street estimates for second-quarter profit.It saw strong trading in equities, options and prediction markets, but weakness in crypto trading.Analysts argue the quick expansion of prediction markets has turned investor focus away from crypto.And market watchers now expect the prediction sector to play an even more key role in Robinhood's revenue mix.
